dashboard.loginHint: Account status (linked devices, sync versions) is visible right away. Bookmarks stay end-to-end encrypted and are never visible to the server - you can optionally decrypt them right here in your browser with your recovery passphrase, to compare against what's in your browser.
dashboard.syncStatusHint: Whether each data type has ever synced from any device, and the version/size/timestamp of what's currently stored - the quickest way to check "did my last sync actually save?" without opening the extension.
dashboard.bookmarksHint: Decrypted entirely in this browser tab using your recovery passphrase - the passphrase and the decrypted bookmarks never leave your device or reach the server. Useful for comparing what's actually saved against what's in your browser.
dashboard.wrongPassphrase: Wrong recovery passphrase - could not unlock.
dashboard.noBookmarksSynced: No bookmarks have been synced yet.
dashboard.devicesHint: Every device currently signed into this account. Revoke anything you don't recognize - a "never used" badge usually means a leftover from reinstalling the extension rather than a device someone's actually using.
